name: 林政
title: Professor
bio: Professor at IIE, CAS and chair professor at UCAS. Author of two monographs and 100+ CCF-A/B publications, with repeated national first-place finishes in machine reading comprehension and sentiment analysis evaluations (2018/2019/2024/2025).

name: 王伟平
title: Professor
bio: Professor at IIE, CAS and Vice Director of the institute. Has led 30+ major national R&D and information-security engineering projects, with 100+ publications in venues such as TPAMI, TPDS, NeurIPS, CVPR and ICDE.

name: 付鹏
title: Associate Professor
bio: Associate Professor at IIE, CAS. 30+ publications in ACL, AAAI, IJCAI, EMNLP, TASLP and ACM MM; first place in the national 'Military Intelligence – Machine Reading' challenge in 2018 and 2019.

name: 吴大衍
title: Associate Professor
bio: Associate Professor at IIE, CAS. 30+ publications in CVPR, SIGIR, IJCAI, AAAI, ACM MM, TCSVT and TOMM; recipient of the 2020 First Prize of the Ministry of Education Science and Technology Progress Award.

name: 谷井子
title: Senior Engineer
bio: Senior Engineer at IIE, CAS. 20+ publications in CVPR, ACM MM, ECCV, ICME and ICASSP, with multiple granted invention patents.
